notes: UNVERIFIED CANDIDATES — NOT PLAYABLE. Coordinates are proposed, not confirmed. No candidate may enter src/data/locations.ts until `npm run catalog:verify -- data/candidates/batch-001.json --verify-panoramas` resolves a real panorama id for it. There are deliberately no panoId fields here; the batch schema has no such field, and any value in it would be a fabrication. Composition targets the worst-failing release gates rather than raw count: 28 Hard candidates (15 remote, 13 rural) to fix a Hard tier that currently has zero of either, 12 Normal (7 suburban, 5 rural) to fix all three Normal balance gates, 37 countries across all six realistically-covered continents, weighted toward Africa/Oceania/South America which sit furthest below the 15-group continent floor. No US, and at most three per country.

candidates.label: Trans-Kalahari Highway near Kang
candidates.source: Trans-Kalahari Highway (A2) corridor, open scrub between Kang and Ghanzi
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote, the single largest gap. Botswana is a new country and Africa is the thinnest continent (4 groups against a floor of 15).

candidates.label: Moteng Pass, Lesotho highlands
candidates.source: A1 mountain road over Moteng Pass, northern Lesotho
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote high-altitude road. New country; a landlocked mountain kingdom is a genuinely difficult guess with no urban cues.

candidates.label: Great Karoo, Western Cape
candidates.source: N1 corridor across the Great Karoo, inland of Beaufort West
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote semi-desert. South Africa already appears once (Cape Town, urban) but this is ~450 km away and a completely different setting.

candidates.label: Desert road near Douz
candidates.source: Road south of Douz toward the Sahara margin
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote Saharan margin. New country; adds North African desert, which the catalog has only as a Giza landmark.

candidates.label: RN7 near Isalo
candidates.source: Route Nationale 7 through the Isalo massif
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. New country and a new island biome; also feeds the derived Islands collection.

candidates.label: Farmland near Malkerns
candidates.source: MR27 through the Malkerns valley farmland
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. New country; small southern-African states are hard to distinguish from their neighbours, which is exactly the intended difficulty.

candidates.label: Farmland below Kilimanjaro
candidates.source: Rural road between Moshi and Arusha
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural East African smallholding. New country; 350 km from the existing Nairobi entry.

candidates.label: Route de Cilaos
candidates.source: RN5 switchbacks into the Cirque de Cilaos
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural volcanic island interior. New territory; French road furniture in the Indian Ocean is a deliberately misleading cue.

candidates.label: Tea country near Fort Portal
candidates.source: Rural road through tea estates west of Fort Portal
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural equatorial highland. New country; adds an African interior that is neither desert nor savanna.

candidates.label: Outskirts of Cape Coast
candidates.source: Residential road on the edge of Cape Coast
candidates.rationale: Normal/suburban — the setting the Normal tier has zero of. New country; West Africa is entirely absent from the catalog.

candidates.label: Terraced hills near Musanze
candidates.source: Rural road among terraced farmland near Musanze
candidates.rationale: Normal/rural. New country; terraced volcanic hill farming is visually distinctive enough to be Normal rather than Hard.

candidates.label: Eyre Highway, Nullarbor Plain
candidates.source: Eyre Highway crossing the Nullarbor, Western Australia
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. Australia already appears twice but both are city landmarks; the Nullarbor is ~2,000 km from either.

candidates.label: Landsborough Highway, outback Queensland
candidates.source: Landsborough Highway near Winton, central Queensland
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote red-earth outback. Third and final Australian entry in this batch, deliberately capped.

candidates.label: Midland farmland near Ross, Tasmania
candidates.source: Midland Highway farmland near Ross, Tasmania
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. Tasmanian midlands read as northern-European farmland, which makes them a properly hard guess.

candidates.label: Central Otago near Alexandra
candidates.source: Rural road in the Central Otago basin near Alexandra
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural dry inland basin, ~63 km from the existing Queenstown entry so it forms no cluster.

candidates.label: Coromandel coastal road
candidates.source: Coastal road on the Coromandel Peninsula
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural coast, ~66 km from the existing Auckland entry. Caps New Zealand at two additions despite existing over-representation.

candidates.label: Queens Road near Sigatoka
candidates.source: Queens Road along the Coral Coast, Viti Levu
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural Pacific island. New country; Oceania is 10 groups below its floor and currently only Australia and New Zealand.

candidates.label: Coastal road, Tutuila
candidates.source: Coastal road on Tutuila island
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. New territory in the South Pacific; US road signage in Polynesia is a deliberately confusing cue.

candidates.label: Coastal road, Guam
candidates.source: Coastal road near Tumon, Guam
candidates.rationale: Normal/suburban. New territory; adds Micronesia and one of the seven suburban entries this batch needs.

candidates.label: Island road, Saipan
candidates.source: Beach Road, Saipan
candidates.rationale: Normal/suburban. New territory ~220 km from Guam, so the two form no cluster.

candidates.label: Ruta 40, Patagonian steppe
candidates.source: Ruta Nacional 40 across the Patagonian steppe near Perito Moreno
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. Argentina's only existing entry is the Buenos Aires obelisk, ~1,700 km north.

candidates.label: Altiplano road near Uyuni
candidates.source: Highland road on the altiplano near Uyuni
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote high-altitude desert. New country; South America is 9 groups below its floor.

candidates.label: Inland Atacama Desert
candidates.source: Inland desert route east of Antofagasta
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. Chile's two existing entries are both central-coast cities ~1,000 km south; this adds the driest desert on the planet.

candidates.label: Altiplano near Juliaca
candidates.source: Altiplano road near Juliaca, Lake Titicaca basin
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. ~330 km from the existing Cusco entry, so no cluster; treeless altiplano is unlike anything else in the catalog.

candidates.label: Andean valley near Baños
candidates.source: Valley road near Baños de Agua Santa
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural equatorial Andes. New country; adds the northern Andes to a South America that is currently southern-cone heavy.

candidates.label: Coffee country near Salento
candidates.source: Rural road through the coffee region near Salento
candidates.rationale: Normal/rural. Colombia's only entry is Caribbean-coast Cartagena, ~640 km north.

candidates.label: Open campo near Tacuarembó
candidates.source: Ruta 5 through open grazing country near Tacuarembó
candidates.rationale: Normal/rural pampas. New country; rolling grassland is a fair Normal guess with vegetation and signage cues.

candidates.label: Serra Gaúcha near Gramado
candidates.source: Residential streets in the Serra Gaúcha highlands
candidates.rationale: Normal/suburban. Brazil's only entry is Copacabana, ~1,100 km north; alpine-styled southern Brazil is a useful counterweight.

candidates.label: Steppe road near Kharkhorin
candidates.source: Steppe road in the Orkhon valley near Kharkhorin
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. New country; open steppe with no built cues is close to the hardest guess the format allows.

candidates.label: Mountain road near Naryn
candidates.source: High mountain road in the Naryn region
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. New country; Central Asia is entirely absent from the catalog.

candidates.label: Desert Highway near Ma'an
candidates.source: Desert Highway (Route 15) near Ma'an
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. New country; ~200 km from the existing Jerusalem entry and a completely different landscape.

candidates.label: Punakha valley road
candidates.source: Valley road below Punakha
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural Himalayan valley. New country; distinctive architecture keeps it fair rather than impossible.

candidates.label: Hill country near Ella
candidates.source: Rural road through tea country near Ella
candidates.rationale: Normal/rural. New country; also feeds the derived Islands and Left-Side Driving collections.

candidates.label: Outskirts of Ipoh
candidates.source: Suburban road on the edge of Ipoh, Perak
candidates.rationale: Normal/suburban. New country; adds mainland Southeast Asian suburbia and another Left-Side Driving member.

candidates.label: Cloud forest road near Monteverde
candidates.source: Unpaved road approaching Monteverde
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural cloud forest. New country; Central America is absent apart from Mexico.

candidates.label: Highlands near Chichicastenango
candidates.source: Highland road near Chichicastenango
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural Mayan highlands. New country; ~700 km from the nearest existing entry (Oaxaca).

candidates.label: Blue Mountains road
candidates.source: Mountain road above Kingston in the Blue Mountains
candidates.rationale: Normal/rural. New country; Caribbean coverage is currently one Havana entry, and Jamaica adds a Left-Side Driving island.

candidates.label: Residential Nuuk
candidates.source: Residential streets in Nuuk
candidates.rationale: Normal/suburban — honestly a small Arctic town, not a remote wilderness, so it is not tagged remote. New territory and the catalog's only Arctic entry.

candidates.label: Highland road near Möðrudalur
candidates.source: Ring Road across the northeastern highlands near Möðrudalur
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. Iceland's existing entry is central Reykjavík ~450 km away; treeless volcanic highland is a genuinely hard guess.

candidates.label: Village above Geirangerfjord
candidates.source: Village road above Geirangerfjord
candidates.rationale: Normal/suburban. New country; only two European candidates in this batch because Europe is already the best-covered continent.
